data.content: {"stage":"review","round":1,"verdict":"fail","blocking_count":2,"warning_count":1,"findings":[{"check_id":"CRIT-MISREPRESENTED","severity":"blocking","item_key":"BE-status-change-error-handling","requirement_ids":["R-9dc414dc"],"message":"The task says an invalid input error is returned when the status is 'not Open or Completed'. This contradicts US-change-task-status AC6, where the endpoint accepts only Completed and rejects any other value. It also conflicts with BE-status-change-endpoint, which says 'Only the Completed value is accepted'. A developer could build the validation wrongly and accept Open.","suggested_fix":"Change the rule to: return an invalid input error for any status value other than Completed."},{"check_id":"CRIT-CONSTRAINT","severity":"blocking","item_key":"US-change-task-status","requirement_ids":["R-d57336f7"],"message":"The status change is not a create, update or delete action. The PRD still requires a success or error message for such actions (R-d57336f7), and the story shows success and error messages. The story does not cite R-d57336f7, and FE-status-toggle-control does not cite it either. The traceability is incomplete, so the message requirement is not tied to the PRD text.","suggested_fix":"Add R-d57336f7 to the requirements of US-change-task-status and FE-status-toggle-control, or note the open question that the PRD only names create/update/delete for messages."},{"check_id":"CRIT-OVERLAP","severity":"warning","item_key":"BE-task-update-endpoint","requirement_ids":[],"message":"The task requires PUT /tasks/{id} to reject an invalid Status value (US-update-task AC12). The update endpoint accepts only Title, Description, Priority and Due Date and does not accept Status. Status changes are handled by BE-status-change-endpoint. The Status validation therefore has no input to validate and partly duplicates the status endpoint's validation.","suggested_fix":"Narrow the task: state that PUT ignores or rejects a Status field, and keep Status value validation in BE-status-change-error-handling."}]}
